title: Maximum Edge Open Packing in Permutation, Interval, and Well-Partitioned Chordal Graphs
summary: Edge open packing is a relaxation of induced matching in which the selected edges may induce disjoint stars. We study the \textsc{Maximum Edge Open Packing} problem on permutation graphs, interval graphs, and well-partitioned chordal graphs. For the first two classes, we introduce an oriented star-conflict graph whose vertices are ordered edges. We prove that its compatibility graph admits a natural transitive orientation: a product-order orientation for permutation graphs and a left-to-right orientation for interval graphs.
